austin.summary: Austin, you drafted last and you drafted late — and somehow your back half is the best half in the game. Carter and Eric are tied at 12 pts, rank 1 of 21, both still standing on Tovuto, which is why you're sitting rank 3 of 5 with 34 counted points. Yes, the front of your board burned down. But there are 38 points still on the table and the leader has 48. That's a gap, not a grave.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Eric at pick #16 ranks 1 is the steal of this entire draft, and Carter at pick #15 matched him at 12 pts — two late swings, two bullseyes.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Jenna at pick #6 went out 4th in Ep 4 with 4 pts, rank 17 of 21, and Linnea at pick #5 followed one episode later with 6 pts — two early picks, two F's, and a Draft GPA of 2 to show for it.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Your Ep 3 high was +8 and your Ep 6 low was +2, so the story now is whether that Tovuto pair can push you back toward big weeks with two of four still in the game.

kylie.summary: Kylie, you took the first punch of this season — Aaliyah went home in Episode 1 and the First Blood badge is yours forever. But look what's still standing: Cristian and Kilby, both sitting at 12 pts, both ranked 1 of 21, both loud, chaotic, and absolutely alive. You're rank 5 of 5 with 29 counted points, and yes, the leader has 48 — but there are 38 points still on the table. Episode 7 gave you +8. You are not out of this.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Kilby at pick #18 is the steal of the draft — 12 pts, rank 1 of 21, a grade A, and a game designer thinking three steps ahead alongside Cristian, who matches him point for point.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Aaliyah at pick #3 was the reach — 0 pts, rank 21 of 21, grade F — and losing Alexis in Episode 5 at 5 pts left you with 2 of 4 still in the game.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Two Tovuto chaos agents tied at the very top — watch whether Cristian and Kilby keep climbing together or start pulling in different directions.

tami.summary: Tami, you own three Tovuto players sitting at 12 pts apiece, tied at rank 1 of 21, and that's why you're rank 2 of 5 with 39 counted points. The leftover, Sharonda at pick #21, scores like a first-rounder — that's Leftover Luck, and your roster's 2 idols and advantages earned Idol Whisperer too. Ep 7 gave you +12. Draft GPA 2.4 says messy; the scoreboard says dangerous.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Angelica, Mike and Sharonda are all tied at 12 pts and rank 1 of 21 — a three-headed engine humming out of Tovuto.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Patt went at pick #10 and finished rank 18 of 21 with 3 pts after being 3rd voted out in Ep 3, while Rob's 2 pts get dropped under the best-4 rule.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: The leader sits at 48 with 52 points still on the table — every episode your three survivors stay in the game is another swing at that gap.

taylor.summary: Taylor, you drafted 2nd and landed Kristin Flickinger with pick #2 — rank 1 of 21, 12 pts, and still out there. The problem? Torches. You've earned the Torch Collector badge with 3 torches snuffed, you sit rank 4 of 5 with 31 counted points, and your draft GPA is 1.75. But hear me out: 24 points are still on the table, the leader has 48, and Ep 7 handed you +7. You are absolutely still in contention.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Kristin Flickinger, 49, crisis management, your pick #2 — rank 1 of 21 with 12 pts and the only one of your four still in the game.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Ana Sani at pick #12 is your reach — she ranks 20, scored 1 pts, graded F, and her game ended on Day 5 in 20th place, while Brady Booker at pick #19 (ranks 13, grade A) was the steal you needed more of.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Your Idol Whisperer badge says this roster finds things — 2 idols and advantages found — so keep your eyes on whether Kristin's determined, joyful mischief can close the gap on that 48.

tim.summary: Tim, you drafted fourth and somehow walked away with an entire tribe intact. Four for four still in the game, every one of them through the merge, and a 3.75 draft GPA to show for it. You're rank 1 of 5 with 48 counted points, you've led or co-led after every single elimination, and nine boots have come and gone without touching you. Ep 7 gave you +16. That, Tim, is a statement.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Nobody's carrying anybody — Lewis, Maggie, Devin and Thien An are all sitting at 12 pts and all ranked 1 of 21, with Thien An at pick #17 standing as the steal of the draft.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Ep 1 was your worst week at +4, Lewis is the lone B on an otherwise A-graded roster, and with 66 points still on the table a 48-point lead is not a locked door.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Your Idol Whisperer badge says this crew has already dug up 2 idols and advantages — keep an eye on who's holding the hardware and when they decide to use it.
